cards.title: Rent burden rebalance (0.4284 vs 0.40 ceiling)
cards.note: DELIVERED - branch balance/pedro/rent-burden (rebase onto master, ready to merge). Two coupled fixes: (1) ConsumerSpending caps discretionary spend by the household's rent obligation - kills the consumption-vs-rent competition and the off-ledger wealth drain (Gini). (2) HousingOptions.MaxRentIndex 1.6 -> 1.2 - a market-wide rent-index cap lowers rents uniformly so the burden distribution moves naturally, NOT a per-lease clip. Market-lever comparison: UBI 100 fixes rent but inflates money supply to 0.16 (rejected); construction trigger overshoots vacancy 0.125>0.12 and leaves 2k at 0.4064 (rejected); a per-lease affordability cap passes but pins the median on the cap - clipped (rejected). seed21 decade rent 0.4619/0.4041/0.4619/0.4619 -> 0.2093/0.2917/0.3359/0.3446 at 60/200/1k/2k; Gini 0.76/0.78/0.77/0.79 -> 0.50/0.55/0.57/0.57. BalanceScenarioTests 4/4 (was 3 fail), fast suite 595/0/0, conservation gap 0, no company failures.
